group_move.description: Move printed group 12 immediately before printed group 8. Preserve every coordinate value and all other relative group orders.

records.unresolved_fields: The single connective position retains its complete domain. O and U are readable possibilities, not selected assignments.

geometry_selection.scope: Identity plus every move of one complete five-coordinate group among all 37 complete groups; the final one-coordinate tail remains fixed.
geometry_selection.masked_fields: All eight footer positions; no personal names, unit numbers or quantities enter the geometry objective. The uncertain ST?R?ER span and connective are also excluded.
geometry_selection.objective: Minimum count of disagreements at observed source coordinates required by the ordinary-word mask, under the unchanged key. Printed erasures carry no mismatch cost.
geometry_selection.selection_caveat: Ordinary-word anchors were developed after inspecting the damaged target and an exploratory local permutation screen. This is a conditional consistency comparison, not a blind decipherment or global language proof.

fresh_control.design: New ordinary prose of 85 characters plus an eight-character footer; same length, key ranks, printed-erasure positions, and one full-group displacement as the target model. The same binary ordinary-word mask is applied; no footer character enters geometry selection.
fresh_control.limitations: A fresh implementation and sensitivity control for this exact family of group-displacement errors, not a general recovery-rate estimate.
